trail.text: Failure flagged — I’ll trace the latency and error spikes to the source.
Many services show latency — now I’ll pinpoint which one started it.
Early signs focus on travel and route — I’ll confirm the onset order.

causes.reasoning: Earliest and sharpest relative jump at 5-10s with persistent 2s p99 and disproportionate CPU collapse indicating internal blocking that would stall its callers travel/travel2.
Immediate onset at 10s with sustained 3-4s p95 and reduced CPU/requests consistent with waiting on slow route dependency while propagating to admin and UI.
Coincident 10s spike to ~5-7s p99 with increased CPU and memory-failures suggesting overloaded sibling path sharing the route bottleneck.
Delayed p50 jump at 50s after travel/route onset with only latency deviation and falling CPU indicating victim waiting rather than origin.
Transient memory-failures 20-60s with cache rise that resolves while travel/route latencies persist, indicating secondary pressure not the persistent root.
